definition: An evergreen creative territory where body care is embedded in a real shower, shave or getting-ready routine. It can be executed as a voice-over review or a trendy-music edit.

references.evidence_role: Evergreen format reference — not viral proof
references.first_frame: After-shaving leg routine title in a real bathroom setting
references.story_pattern: Skin context → ordered routine steps → product integration → smoother-looking finish
references.why_it_works: The product earns relevance as one useful step inside an existing behavior instead of interrupting the routine as an ad.
references.coba_adaptation: Integrate one CoBa product into a 3–5 step low-maintenance shower or shaving routine and explain the job it performs in natural American English.
references.contact_status: Creator lists collaboration contact in bio; use the profile contact route

references.evidence_role: Viral execution reference — creator is not US-based
references.first_frame: Post-shower towel-wrap shot holding the routine products with a clear promise overlay
references.story_pattern: Outcome promise → fast product stack → tactile application cuts → smooth-legs payoff
references.why_it_works: The edit is instantly readable without dialogue, feels candid and creates product-search intent through a simple combo reveal.
references.coba_adaptation: Use a rising commercially cleared sound, 4–7 beat-matched close-ups and one plain-English overlay such as ‘the Vietnamese bodycare combo for smooth-looking legs.’
references.contact_status: Creator lists collaboration contact in bio; use the profile contact route

trend_sources.label: TikTok Creative Center — #bodycareroutine
trend_sources.use: Recheck related videos and regional popularity during each scan; validate each post's current public metrics separately.
